reviews.text:
Incredible! He has such knowledge. In just two days, he won over my dog ​​Zuri, and she's going to miss him.
He's taught me how to understand her better and correct her bad habits. Borja is a true professional.

Borja is a true professional, and his passion for his work is evident. I came from Barcelona with Rudolph, a rather nervous and reactive dachshund in certain situations, and in just six classes, he has helped me tremendously in working with him. Although we still have a way to go, I'm finally starting to see the light at the end of the tunnel.

I was looking for a dog trainer who wouldn't just put a band-aid on things, but would address the root causes of problems, and it has definitely been the right choice. Furthermore, the classes have been both educational and fun; I left each one with a wealth of information and tools to continue working with Rudi at home. You only had to see the joyful lambadas Rudolph did every time he saw Borja! ☺️

Thank you so much, Borja, for helping us and for improving Rudi's quality of life so much 💚

Borja helped us from the very first day we took in our potentially dangerous breed puppy. Abandoned in a trash can, she hadn't been with her mother and siblings, and we needed a professional to guide us. And that's exactly what he did. Reading reviews, everyone agrees on his professionalism, but he's more than that; he's someone special. He understands dogs like no one else, with love and respect. Frida loves him, and I'm absolutely certain that without him, everything would have been very different and much, much more difficult, if not impossible. He's made me proud of my dog. When I got pregnant, he continued to help and advise us. I think we've succeeded in making Frida happy with her little sister, and their relationship is fantastic. I don't know how to thank him enough. No one should hesitate to contact him if they have a problem because they won't regret it. He creates happy dogs. Thank you so much from the bottom of my heart.

Borja is a true professional; you can tell he loves what he does. He explains each exercise with incredible patience.
We are absolutely delighted with his teachings. Before meeting him, our walks with my little one were chaotic 😅 Now we enjoy every walk and can go anywhere thanks to his tips.
Oreo adores him; he loves that he teaches him so many new things.

We've worked with Borja to help Greta adjust to her new life after leaving the shelter, and we couldn't be happier. The change in her is remarkable; she's much less fearful, and her integration with our first dog is progressing very well. Without a doubt, Borja truly understands our dogs' needs and helps us understand them better so they can live the fullest lives possible.

Meeting Borja has been wonderful. He's guided us and taught us how to manage Frankie's reactivity much better. He connected with her from the very first session, and she with him was fantastic. Every time he comes to our house, it's a celebration. She's calmer now, and as a result, so are we. Thank you!

Our experience with Borja has been wonderful. From the very first moment, he connected with Oreo, and Oreo with him.
Oreo is quite a special and sensitive little dog, so we still have some work to do with him. But if there's one thing I'm sure of, it's that we'll get there. Our walks before are nothing like they are now, and although we have some rough days, we continue working on it daily. I wish we had met Borja sooner, especially because thanks to him, Oreo enjoys playing with his chew toys and "doing nothing" on walks. He loves lying on the grass, in the middle of the street, or wherever he feels like, observing his surroundings, the people, and everything around him without getting upset. 🥰🙏🏽

Borja is an amazing person. He's taught us to understand our dogs and to see and treat them in a completely different way. We have a much stronger connection with them, and they seem so much happier. Not to mention how much they love Borja. A 10 out of 10!

We're so happy with the experience 😊 We still have work to do, but we feel like we're learning so much. More than training her, it's teaching us to understand her, communicate better, and know how to guide her in a healthy and respectful way.

The sessions are very educational, but also fun and enjoyable, so we always end up learning and having a great time at the same time!
I know our little wolf, Arena, and Borja will soon be great friends 🐾
We highly recommend it! 😊

We had a lot of problems with Rey's reactivity towards other dogs. Thanks to Borja's work, we've been able to walk him much more calmly and better understand how to help him in those situations. He was always incredibly patient, explained everything very clearly, and adapted the training to our dog's needs. The change has been remarkable. Highly recommended for anyone who needs real, professional help with their dog.
A wonderful person and an even better professional. She helped us manage our stubborn little furry friend. She gave us the guidance we needed to improve her life, and ours. We are very grateful 😊 …

Working with Borja has been a pleasure. From the very first moment, he connected with Ona and with us, and it has been very easy to learn how to address the behavioral issues we were having with her. We still have work ahead of us, but Borja has been very helpful in teaching us how to improve our relationship with her and how to enjoy our walks and her company. He is a true professional. I recommend him to anyone who needs his services.

Borja has worked with my adopted Czechoslovakian Wolfdog, Hiro, who suffered from severe separation anxiety. Thanks to Borja, he has improved tremendously and can now stay alone for four or five hours (we haven't tried more than that yet), whereas before he couldn't even stay alone for five minutes. He has improved in every other aspect as well, although separation anxiety was the most serious issue. A perfect 10!

Meeting and working with Borja has undoubtedly been the best experience I've ever had with a dog trainer. From the very first moment, his passion, patience, and respect for animals are evident. He not only understands their language perfectly, but he also conveys a genuine love that makes them always feel in the best hands.

My dog, Teo, connected with him instantly, and seeing how Borja works, with that blend of professionalism and affection, is truly wonderful. He explains everything clearly, adapts to each individual case, and achieves results naturally and with an incredibly positive approach.

I would recommend Borja to absolutely everyone. If you love your dog and are looking for someone who will treat them as if they were their own, who will teach you, support you, and make the process a wonderful experience, he is the right person.
I couldn't be more grateful for his work!

Laura has helped us so much this month with our puppy. She's taught us how to understand her better and how to handle her, and she's explained everything perfectly.
A great trainer and a wonderful person.

Our experience with Borja has been wonderful! He's always been willing to help and make the sessions easier. He got along great with our dog from the very first moment and taught us positive reinforcement training methods.
We'll continue applying what he taught us and will definitely have more sessions. Thank you so much because we're already starting to see the changes! 🤗

We're extremely happy with Borja's work and the progress our dog Mario has made with him. We've seen very positive results from day one. His method is very effective, and everything is focused on the dog's well-being and developing their abilities. I would recommend him to anyone.
Our mastiff has learned a lot from Borja's training sessions. Highly recommended!

It's been a pleasure working with Borja! He helped us understand Limón from the very beginning. We were having some issues with his reactivity towards other dogs, and thanks to Borja, we've learned how to manage it in the best way possible! Both Limón and we are very grateful for his helpfulness and professionalism :)
Borja's dedication, care, and the way he treats us have taught us how to truly appreciate our dog. Thank you so much for your hard work and commitment.

Borja is a fantastic professional! Mushu is a timid and very sensitive greyhound. Walks with him used to be a constant state of hypervigilance, constantly pulling away from every dog ​​he saw, and he was always reactive and stressed! We've worked a lot with Borja, both at home and on the street, learning new things about Mushu and discovering how quickly he can learn. Mushu has made a wonderful and beautiful change and is now able to enjoy his walks! We still have to keep working with him because we started from a pretty difficult situation. But thanks to Borja, we have the tools to improve together.

We've passed the walking test, now we want to improve our grades! 😜 Thank you, Borja!
Borja has been wonderful. He has worked with great professionalism on the training and education of our dog.

Thank you so much, Borja. From the very first session, he's had a great connection with my dog. The results are showing quickly, in just a few days.
He's also teaching me how to communicate better with him. You can tell he loves what he's doing. Thanks for everything!

Borja has helped us manage my dog ​​Rolo's reactivity. It's incredible how he connected with him and gained his trust in such a short time! In just five classes, we've seen a huge difference in Rolo's behavior, and above all, we have more tools and knowledge to guide him better and help him manage different encounters with other dogs! Highly recommended!! His methods are very gentle and based on building trust with the dog!

Borja is the best trainer we could have for Calambur! He's quite a challenge of a dog, and it's a joy to see Borja in action: how he understands him, manages him, and helps you manage him, always in a way that makes the little dog happy and helps him overcome his fears.
Borja is an excellent coach and person. He completely adapted to our situation and gave us guidelines for continuing to train after the scheduled sessions. Very flexible and approachable.

After many failed attempts with various professionals, I found Borja, and he was a lifesaver (for my dog ​​and me). He's the best! I will definitely always recommend him; what a difference we've made! Of course, there's still work to be done, but his guidance and dedication to the dogs are key! Thank you so much, Borja!

We've had a wonderful experience with Borja; he's been a great help in training our puppy, Oreo.

He's a very kind and caring person when it comes to animals. It's clear that he's passionate about it.

Borja has been a huge help!
We have two dogs. One of them, the younger one, is very fearful and nervous, and we've noticed a great improvement little by little. Nala is also learning to manage her stress.
The treatment has been excellent, very respectful to both the dogs and the family, which is greatly appreciated.
We've had five sessions, and each one has been very productive. He's also helped us a lot with various tools and advice.
We're so happy!

We wanted to thank Borja, because before working with him we had no hope of ever having a normal life with our dog. He showed us the way forward and has left us with a happy and well-balanced dog. I hope many more dogs will put themselves in your hands so they and their owners can be just as happy as we are.

Borja is wonderful. A magnificent trainer and an even better person. I'm so lucky to have found him. I doubt there's a better professional. My dog ​​Lana adores him. We've had five lessons so far, but we'll definitely have more and stay in touch!

We're thrilled with Borja! Since we started working with him, we've noticed an incredible improvement in our dog's behavior. He has a real gift for connecting with dogs, and it's clear he knows exactly what he's doing. His techniques are super effective, always explained clearly and with a very respectful approach. He's also given us tons of practical tools to continue working at home, which has made the whole process much easier and more manageable.

Thank you so much, Borja! You've helped us immensely, and we couldn't be happier with the results.

10/10
Borja has been the best trainer Manolito could have had. He's helped us with his fears, stress, insecurities, and a thousand other problems we told him about. He's been the best! ♥️
Borja has helped us immensely. Kiwa was a very insecure and fearful dog, but thanks to his advice and exercises, she has improved tremendously and is now much more self-assured. 100% recommended.
Borja helped Kiwi and me a lot...especially in understanding him from when he was a puppy and in allowing me to learn and let him be.

It's been amazing from the very first moment. We've discovered a whole new world at home, and of course, the way they treat both the dog and us is unbeatable. Thank you, Borja, for helping us so much and showing us how we can help Pongo manage his behavior ✨
We're absolutely thrilled with Borja! He treated both our pet and us incredibly well, and his professionalism is outstanding. We're so happy with the results!

I've had many dogs throughout my life and many trainers. The best trainer for Chumbo and me has been Borja. Classes with him are a joy for both of us, and we always learn something new. He doesn't just teach commands, but also the best way to interact with our dogs and create a strong bond. I'm delighted.

Absolutely 100% recommended. Borja works with great technical knowledge and heart, understanding the dog and its family from the very first moment, making the teams work together and be happier. Phillip and I are very grateful.

We've been working with Borja for a while now and we're thrilled!
He's formed a wonderful bond with Baileys and we're already seeing improvements in his behavior.
This allows us to enjoy and share more adventures and experiences every day. All the guidelines and recommendations are based on respectful and positive training.
Thank you so much, Borja! We highly recommend him!!!
I'm delighted with Borja; my dog ​​has changed since the first week. She's much calmer and more relaxed. Everything was very entertaining and educational.
Borja is an incredible educator. Natalio made great progress with him, and we learned so much about how to interact with him. Natalio will definitely miss him!

Aitana's Case.
We had sessions with the professional Olaf. Our case involved a dog we had adopted recently, who was very insecure, fearful, and exhibited stylotypical behaviors. Our starting point was a dog who never wanted to leave the house, but now she's moved to tears by a simple word. She went from not paying much attention to someone who was much more attentive. Today, we have a wonderful companion, and her happiness is evident. It's been a very positive change, and we always communicated calmly. We highly recommend the service provided, and we, as a family, are very happy.

Our dog, Drako, was very difficult to train at six months old, especially since he had bad hygiene habits and was destroying everything. After five sessions with Borja, his attitude changed dramatically. Drako is now very obedient, and we …

We have a very fearful and insecure little dog, although she's also very protective in certain situations, which was dangerous considering how small she is.
Borja helped us address this problem, as well as many others he noticed, and …
Borja is an excellent trainer. We couldn't be happier with his approach and, above all, his dedication to our puppy. We've seen so many improvements, and she's only 9 months old! …

How lucky we were to find Borja!
It's wonderful to meet people who are so passionate about what they do! We've learned to connect better with our dog, to understand her needs and how to provide …

Highly recommended. We went from being afraid to adopt a high-energy dog ​​like a Border Collie to becoming the perfect guides for our Golfo. Thank you, Borja, for your teachings, advice, and support... I don't know if he taught the dog more or us, but it was one of the best investments we could have made (by far!).

Highly recommended! We went to Borja to address the restlessness of our dog, Odin, a very sweet but very nervous and dependent dog. Borja is a true professional who quickly warmed up to him and gave us many tools to understand our little …
